description:
Pre-merge review pass over the entire crate-pkix workspace at HEAD (96 commits ahead of origin/main, v0.2.0 across all 11 crates).

## Scope
All 11 crates: pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-chain-simple, pkix-path-builder, pkix-revocation-http, pkix-profiles, pkix-lint, pkix-ct, pkix-composite, pkix-ac.

## Section 0 anchor
README claims (workspace-level + per-crate) vs. actual public API/code state. Identify drift, lies, broken doctests, unimplemented features advertised as present.

## Baseline state at review time
- cargo check --workspace --all-features: clean
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean
- cargo test --workspace: all pass (no failures, some ignored doctests, several no_run examples)
- 0 open beads issues, 865 closed
- workspace v0.2.0; pkix-revocation-http/pkix-ct/pkix-composite/pkix-ac at v0.1.1 ("planned"/stub)
- 18,947 lines of Rust across src+tests

## Workflow
Pass 1 of review-loop: file every finding (P0–P4) under this epic. Then /review-rusty, then /do-beads.
title: review-myoss epic — full workspace pre-merge review v0.2.0 HEAD
